think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s purpose and data type. 2) Check whether it has documented sentinel/exception values (e.g., -1, 0) that change the knob’s meaning beyond normal numeric ordering. 3) Determine if setting such a value switches the feature into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disables/enables regardless of cost) rather than just adjusting intensity/threshold. 4) If a sentinel exists, record it as the special value and classify as special; otherwise classify as non-special.
